newsitem.title: USA: Alumax denies interest in building Venezuela plant.
newsitem.headline: Alumax denies interest in building Venezuela plant.

text.p: Allen Born, chairman and CEO of Alumax Inc, Wednesday denied that his company was looking to build an aluminum plant in Venezuela.
A Venezuelan government official said Tuesday that Alumax was negotiating power and primary material supply contracts to build a 320,000 metric tonnes per year plant in Venezuela.
"They're out of their minds," Born told two reporters, after speaking at an Aluminum Association conference.
"We decided we did not want to participate," said Born, who is chairman of the association. "There's no need for any additional capacity."
Worldwide primary aluminum capacity is expected to grow 1.7 percent in 1997 to 23.43 million metric tons and reach 24.49 million tons in 1999, he told the association.
